meta.name: ar-status
meta.description: Show experiment dashboard with results, active loops, and progress. Use when the user runs /ar:ar-status or asks how an autoresearch experiment is going.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看自动研究实验的进度与结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在跑自动研究实验,想随时了解进展。
copy.tagline_en: See the progress and results of your autoresearch experiments at a glance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run autoresearch experiments and want to check their progress anytime.

howto.what: 使用 /ar:ar-status 后,Claude 会显示实验仪表盘表格,含实验结果、进行中的循环和进度;还可查看单个实验或某个领域的实验详情,或导出为 CSV/Markdown。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /ar:ar-status,或询问某项自动研究实验进展时触发。

say.note: 展示所有实验的仪表盘。

say.text: ar-status 工程领域的 api-speed 实验进展如何?

howto.what_en: Running /ar:ar-status makes Claude display an experiment dashboard table with results, active loops, and progress. It can also show one experiment, all experiments in a domain, or export the dashboard as CSV or Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /ar:ar-status or asks about the progress of an autoresearch experiment.

say_en.note: Shows the dashboard for all experiments.

say_en.text: How is the api-speed experiment in engineering going?
